notes: Primary constructor field, stored as a private val. Class is otherwise a pure field bag (no methods) mirroring the real Direct3D9 `D3DPRESENT_PARAMETERS` struct almost verbatim: `Windowed`, `Flags`, `FullScreen_RefreshRateInHz`, `EnableAutoDepthStencil`, `SwapEffect`, `BackBufferFormat`, `MultiSampleQuality`, `MultiSampleType`, `AutoDepthStencilFormat`, `BackBufferHeight`, `PresentationInterval`, `BackBufferCount`, `BackBufferWidth` all match the real struct's field names one-to-one (`DeviceWindow` -> real `hDeviceWindow`). Confirmed via D3dRenderDevice.kt: `D3DPRESENT_PARAMETERS(canvas)` constructed with the AWT rendering surface, then `Windowed`/`EnableAutoDepthStencil`/`PresentationInterval` are mutated directly before being passed into `IDirect3DDevice`'s `Reset`/`CreateDevice` calls - exactly how D3DPRESENT_PARAMETERS is used in native D3D9 code. No further renames needed; fields already match the canonical D3D9 struct.
